title: HomeBase 3 provides local BionicMind AI
content: HomeBase S380 centralizes compatible security devices and adds local facial, human, vehicle, package and pet recognition, cross-camera tracking, local storage and automations.

title: HomeBase 3 compatibility spans multiple security form factors
content: HomeBase 3 supports or partially supports cameras, video doorbells, smart locks, entry sensors, motion sensors, keypads, floodlights and other eufy security devices.

title: Motion Sensor E20 offers binary room motion detection
content: The Motion Sensor E20 detects motion with a 90-degree field of view, supports pet-friendly detection, has a five-year battery target and requires a compatible HomeBase.

title: Entry Sensor E20 reports door and window state
content: The Entry Sensor E20 detects opening and closing, supports temporary bypass, has a five-year battery target and can trigger compatible HomeBase automations.

title: eufy emphasizes local processing and storage
content: eufy positions local AI, encryption and expandable local storage without mandatory monthly cloud fees as central security-system benefits.

title: Cross-camera tracking reconstructs a person's route
content: Compatible cameras can identify similar appearances across recordings and merge clips into one event, with processing speed depending on camera and HomeBase AI compatibility.
